title: BlockDrive
tagline: A Blockchain Based File storage web application . It uses Ipfs for storing file
description:
BlockDrive Is a file storage system that is based on Blockchain
It uses Ipfs for storing files on the distributed networks
It stores metadata of the file location on the blockchain.
the user can download the file from the ipfs network
The blockDrive is made using the solidity language
how_its_made:
Ipfs that is responsible for file store on the distributed Networks
Metamask is a wallet that acts as a user identity tool
Solidity is the language that can be understandable by blockchain
Hardhat is used to deploy and test the smart contract
Alchemy is responsible for deploying smart contracts
